summary: Improve cloud cost allocation, forecasting and governance with practical FinOps exercises. Review the course outline and plan your training.
lede: FinOps and cloud cost governance connect cloud spending to service value through shared financial controls and decisions. For FinOps practitioners, cloud finance analysts and engineering leads, the course addresses how to make billing evidence usable for allocation, forecasting and cost ownership. It covers billing-data checks using FOCUS concepts, allocation rules informed by the TBM Taxonomy, forecast-variance review, service-level unit economics and governance reporting.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who work with cloud consumption, financial controls or the decisions that shape digital-service costs. It is designed for people who need to make billing evidence usable across finance, engineering, procurement and product teams.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with cloud services, billing records or technology budgeting is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Exercises use sample billing data and Excel; access to a cloud account or paid software is not required.
